title: 第11章 把酒论英雄第12章 虽千万人吾往矣
lines: 夜里，五人齐聚烟雨楼。
故地重游，又让郭靖想起了昔日因为牛家村和烟雨楼十八年之约而发生的一系列事情。
转眼间自己已经五十，连结义兄弟的儿子，也已经十四岁了。
真是时光如梭，岁月无情。
后来谈及当今天下格局，郭靖的话就更多了。
作为由南明皇帝亲自授衔的参将，郭靖经常往来奔波于南明前线边关，协助指挥抵御蒙元的南下进攻。
虽说南明联合了中唐和北宋，共同抵御外族。
但三国都各有各的敌人。
其中北宋和南明所面对的蒙元，绝对是压力最大的一支。
虽说有北宋一直在旁帮衬，可近来蒙元的精兵强将越来越多，聚集起的武林人士、年轻高手也层出不穷。
尤其是魔门，和蒙元勾结在一起，妄图以蒙元气运，席卷华夏，达成自己破碎虚空的天道追求。
说到国家纷争，最后又不可避免的谈到武者身上。
和原本各自小说格局不同，综武世界上限能到破碎虚空，武者的实力和能力被大大强化。
以一人匹敌一支军队的情况，是完全真实存在的。
昔日蒙元大军入侵，以八师巴为首的国师、魔宗蒙赤行的魔门中人、皇族第一高手思汉飞为统帅，大举南下，妄图血洗吞并北宋和南明。
结果传鹰横空出世，先在杭州镇阻击魔宗蒙赤行，后又与蒙元国师八师巴进行了一场超越时间空间的精神博弈，最终在千军万马下斩杀蒙元统帅思汉飞与上万骑兵，在千丈悬崖上跃入虚空，飘然仙去，留下破碎虚空的不灭美名。
至此，八师巴也堪破破碎虚空之奥妙，不久后也随传鹰一般虚空而去。
蒙赤行心神巨慑，遁回蒙元疗伤。
亲眼见证了破碎虚空，给他造成了巨大的震慑，也让他产生了更高的追求。
惊才绝艳的统帅思汉飞被当场格杀，一人一刀引动雷霆击杀数万铁骑，大大挫败了蒙元士气，也让酝酿已久的进军彻底泡汤，群龙无首。
郭靖望向江寒，眼神中极具欣赏之意。
“以江少侠如今的功力，跻身地榜恐怕不是难事，缺的只是一个机会罢了。”
地榜，专门为江湖15~48岁的年轻人设立的榜单。
在榜之人，无一不是武林赫赫有名的才俊和中流砥柱，也是日后跻身天榜和黑榜的希望所在。
江寒连连摆手：“郭大侠莫要欺我出道晚，我也是看过半月谈的，这地榜上的高手，实力战绩彪炳，无一不是各中强手。一些名字，只是听到便令人心生惊惧，别说是对阵了。”
郭靖却哈哈一笑：“须知三年前，我郭某也在地榜上，后来年纪到了才下的榜。虽已下榜，但这三年实力愈发精进。今日与你三招约战，略逊你一筹，便知你除了今天显现的功夫，还有很多没有显露出来。”
江寒赶忙摆手道：“虽然我身怀《长生诀》奇功，但也只是因缘际会修习了两幅图，并非完全版的《长生诀》。今日切磋也非生死搏杀，郭大侠感念我对杨过的教导，自然也有手下留情的成分在里面，略逊一筹可当不得。”
两位高手在这边寒暄，另外三个小子却坐在一旁，杨过抱着半月谈，双龙挤着脑袋分列左右，听杨过讲最新的地榜人物。
毕竟三个人里，双龙目不识丁，杨过起码桃花岛私塾肄业水平，识字且学过四书五经。
“地榜人物近三年都没有变过了……”
“陆小凤。”
“这个知道，传说中的侠探，四条眉毛的陆小凤！全天下就没有他破不了的案。”
“乔峰。”
“北宋的丐帮帮主，降龙十八掌的三位传承者之一！”
content_en:
At night, five people gathered in Yanyu Tower.
Revisiting the old place reminded Guo Jing of a series of things that happened in the past because of the eighteen-year agreement between Niujiacun and Yanyulou.
In the blink of an eye, he was already fifty, and his sworn brother's son was also fourteen years old.
Time really flies and years are ruthless.
Later, when talking about today's world situation, Guo Jing had even more words to say.
As a staff general personally awarded by the Emperor of Nanming, Guo Jing often traveled to the frontiers of Nanming to help command and resist the southward attack of the Mongolian Yuan Dynasty.
Although the Southern Ming Dynasty united the Central Tang Dynasty and the Northern Song Dynasty to jointly resist foreigners.
But each of the three countries has its own enemies.
Among them, the Mongolian Yuan Dynasty faced by the Northern Song Dynasty and the Southern Ming Dynasty was definitely the one with the greatest pressure.
Although the Northern Song Dynasty has been helping, the Mongolian Yuan Dynasty has recently had more and more elite soldiers and generals, and there are also endless martial arts figures and young masters gathered.
The Demon Sect, in particular, colludes with Meng Yuan in an attempt to use Meng Yuan's luck to sweep across China and achieve their own pursuit of the Heavenly Way of Shattering the Void.
When it comes to national disputes, it inevitably comes to warriors in the end.
Different from the original layout of their respective novels, the upper limit of the comprehensive martial arts world can reach Shattered Void, and the strength and abilities of warriors are greatly enhanced.
The situation of one person against an army is completely real.
In the past, when the Mongolian and Yuan armies invaded, Si Hanfei, the national master led by the Eighth Division Ba, a member of the Demon Sect of the Demon Sect Meng Chixing, and the top master of the royal family, headed south in an attempt to annex the Northern Song Dynasty and Southern Ming Dynasty with blood.
As a result, Chuan Ying was born. He first blocked the demon sect Meng Chixing in Hangzhou Town, and then engaged in a spiritual game that transcended time and space with Meng Yuan's Eighth Division Ba. Finally, he killed Meng Yuan's commander Si Hanfei and tens of thousands of cavalry under thousands of troops. He jumped into the void on a thousand-foot cliff and floated away, leaving behind the immortal reputation of Shattered Void.
At this point, Ba Shiba was able to break through the mystery of the Shattered Void, and soon followed the eagle-like void away.
Meng Chixing was so frightened that he escaped back to Meng Yuan to heal his injuries.
Witnessing the Shattered Void with his own eyes gave him a huge shock, and also gave him a higher pursuit.
The stunningly talented commander Si Hanfei was killed on the spot. One man and one sword triggered thunder and killed tens of thousands of cavalry, which greatly dampened the morale of Meng Yuan and completely ruined the long-awaited march, leaving the group without a leader.
Guo Jing looked at Jiang Han with admiration in his eyes.
"With Jiang Shaoxia's current skill, it may not be difficult to make it to the Earth Ranking. All that is missing is an opportunity."
The local list is a list specially established for young people aged 15 to 48 in the world.
The people on the list are all famous talents and mainstays in the martial arts world, and they are also the hope of joining the Heavenly List and the Black List in the future.
Jiang Han waved his hands repeatedly: "Master Guo, please don't deceive me for debuting late. I have also seen Ban Yue Tan. The masters on this list have outstanding strength and records. They are all strong players. Some names are frightening just hearing them, let alone playing against them."
Guo Jing laughed out loud and said, "It should be noted that three years ago, I, Guo, was also on the local ranking list. I was placed on the ranking list later when I was older. Although I have been placed on the ranking list, my strength has become more and more refined in the past three years. Today I have a three-move battle with you, and I am slightly inferior to you. I know that apart from the skills you showed today, you still have a lot that you have not revealed."
Jiang Han hurriedly waved his hand and said: "Although I have the miraculous skill of "The Secret of Immortality", I have only practiced two pictures by chance, not the complete version of "The Secret of Immortality". Today's competition is not a life and death fight. Daxia Guo is grateful for my teachings to Yang Guo, and naturally there is an element of mercy in it. I can't be inferior."
The two masters were chatting here, but the other three boys were sitting aside. Yang Guo held Ban Yue and talked, and Shuang Long squeezed his head and lined up left and right, listening to Yang Guo talk about the latest people on the land list.
After all, among the three of them, Shuanglong was illiterate, while Yang Guo had at least graduated from a private school on Peach Blossom Island, was literate and had studied the Four Books and Five Classics.
"The characters on the local list have not changed in the past three years..."
"Lu Xiaofeng."
"You know, the legendary detective, Lu Xiaofeng with four eyebrows! There is no case in the world that he can't solve."
"Qiao Feng."
"The leader of the Beggar Clan in the Northern Song Dynasty, one of the three inheritors of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!"
